title: IPsec site-to-site tunnels

live.hint: On while the agent is subscribed to the IKE daemon's SA events; the list then refreshes as soon as an SA changes.

refreshHint: The state is read from the IKE daemon on demand and every 15 s.
pskNotice: Tunnels with a pre-shared key are refused at commit until secrets can be delivered to the data-plane agent. Certificate authentication needs certificates from the PKI screen.
restarted: The IKE daemon restarted since the last reconciliation; its leftover security associations are removed at the next apply.
pendingRestart: The IKE daemon must be restarted to load the new configuration. Until then, tunnels keep running with the previous settings.
emptyProposals: No proposal is configured. Tunnels reference a proposal by name.
name: Name
nameHintTunnel: Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'; up to 60 characters
nameHintProposal: Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'; up to 63 characters

confirmDelete.title: Delete from the candidate?
confirmDelete.tunnels: Tunnel {{name}} is removed from the candidate configuration; it goes down when you commit.
confirmDelete.proposals: Proposal {{name}} is removed from the candidate configuration. Tunnels that still use it fail validation.

sa.title: Security associations — {{name}}
sa.none: No security association is established for this tunnel.

localAddr.title: Local address
localAddr.help: Must be configured on an interface in the underlay VRF

remoteAddr.title: Remote address
remoteAddr.help: The peer's IP address, or %any for a responder-only tunnel

localId.title: Local identity
localId.help: FQDN, e-mail, IP address, @keyid or X.509 DN; default: the local address

remoteId.title: Remote identity
remoteId.help: FQDN, e-mail, IP address, @keyid or X.509 DN; default: the remote address

secretRef.title: Pre-shared key (reference)
secretRef.help: psk/<name> of a stored secret; the key itself is never part of the configuration

certificate.title: Local certificate
certificate.help: Name of a certificate from the PKI screen

remoteCa.title: Remote CA
remoteCa.help: Name of the CA trusted for the peer certificate

localTs.title: Local traffic selectors
localTs.help: One local network; empty selects all traffic in this address family

remoteTs.title: Remote traffic selectors
remoteTs.help: One peer network; empty selects all traffic in this address family

timeoutSec.title: Timeout (s)
timeoutSec.help: IKEv1 only; IKEv2 uses the retransmission timeout

mobike.title: MOBIKE
mobike.help: IKEv2 only; unset = the engine's default

reauth.title: Re-authenticate instead of rekeying the IKE SA

vrf.title: VRF
vrf.help: Overlay: the routing table the traffic selectors apply to

underlayVrf.title: Underlay VRF
underlayVrf.help: Routing table IKE and ESP run in; the local address must be configured in it

ipipInterface.title: IPIP tunnel
ipipInterface.help: Not supported with the IPsec service: such tunnels are refused at commit

prf.title: PRF
prf.help: Defaults to the PRF matching the integrity algorithm

dh.title: PFS DH group
dh.help: Perfect forward secrecy for child SA rekeying; omit to disable

nativeActions.peerRekey: The peer initiates rekey for responder tunnels
